selection_rationale: The smallest-expansion test kills nine concrete routes or missing interfaces but does not refute the three components of a correctly typed absorber theorem. M809R5-04 survives only as a post-output-projection, per-cut theorem that must first construct legal external arcs. M809R5-11 survives as a deterministic matching statement only after every output and hidden switch resource has a proved bounded-overlap ledger and every demand cut is covered. M809R5-06 survives as an optional nibble/cleanup implementation under those same graph-derived hypotheses. The exact search found no legal absorber, no graph-realizable many-legal-absorbers/rank-one counterexample, and no 1/8 progress.
chain_firewall: First construct at least one original-graph switch whose output is a named missing B-edge outside the demand's original K(e) and prove exact C7 legality.
Project certificates to distinct outputs and record all internal resource conflicts before applying DRC or a matching theorem.
Prove expansion for every demand cut after occupied outputs are removed; total catalogue size is insufficient.
If a nibble is used, prove output/resource codegrees and deterministic cleanup of maximum Hall deficiency.
Compose the result with the outer-A gate and every public hard branch before mentioning 1/8.
